name: Hold a text's single default run on the stack

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: TextMeasureInputs::runs() builds a Vec with the one default run whenever a text was not given runs, and shapes_as, decorated_as, update_decoration_runs and the shaping call each ask for it, so a kept text leaf allocated several vectors a frame to compare itself with last frame's.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Return an enum that holds the single run in place (Deref to a slice) in place of Cow::Owned(vec). Test it yields one run over the whole text, and the given runs unchanged. Alternate the previous and new binaries three times on text-relabel, dashboard-all-panels and tree-toggle.
reportMarkdown: A large cut in allocations, CPU slightly down; footprint unchanged. The fast:: tests (440) pass, clippy and fmt are clean.
